mapper.sql: id, dataset_id, tenant_id, version, storage_path, file_size, checksum, row_count, column_info, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.dataset_id, v.tenant_id, v.version, v.storage_path, v.file_size, v.checksum, v.row_count, v.column_info::text AS column_info, v.status, v.created_by, v.created_at, v.updated_at, d.name AS dataset_name, d.description AS dataset_description, d.task_type AS dataset_task_type, d.format AS dataset_format, d.sample_count AS dataset_sample_count FROM dataset_version v LEFT JOIN dataset d ON d.id = v.dataset_id WHERE v.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM dataset_version WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_version (tenant_id, dataset_id, version, storage_path, file_size, checksum, row_count, column_info, status, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{datasetId}, #{version}, #{storagePath}, COALESCE(#{fileSize}, 0), #{checksum}, COALESCE(#{rowCount}, 0), #{columnInfo}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{status}, 'creating'), #{createdBy})
